gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare shown coloured red on Drawing No. KH 2704/1, commencing on Cheong Hang Road 40 m south-west of its junction with Winslow Street and running north-westerly for a distance of approximately 30 m to the entrance of the Public Mortuary.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: KH 2704/1 號圖則內髹紅色之街道，其起點為暢行道與溫思勞街交匯處之西南四十米，向西北行約三十米至公衆殮房入口處。
